title: Projection Drag Templates In Display Windows Panel
description: Follow-up to INFINITE-WORLD-PROJECTION-TAXONOMY: the Display > Fenster (Windows) drag-and-drop palette only ever listed a flat single entry per window kind, never the nested Parallel/Perspective projection tree, because the templateId on WindowTemplateDropPayload was scaffolded but never consumed (handleTemplateDrop ignored it). Wired createWorldProjectionTemplates into buildDisplayWindowsTree (nested per world-3d window kind), added encodeWorldProjectionTemplateId/decodeWorldProjectionTemplateId (infinite/world/r3f/index.tsx), and a client-side WindowInstanceIdContext + pendingWorldProjectionByWindowId side-channel in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx so a dragged template seeds the freshly-opened pane's initial camera via World3dHost's lazy viewportCamera initializer (no Rust/WASM changes needed - each dragged pane is a distinct React component instance with its own local camera-override state). Added tests (infinite-world-r3f: encode/decode round-trip; framework-renderer-react: nested taxonomy tree shape, flat non-world3d fallback, drag-payload decode). Live verification was blocked by a different concurrent session actively hot-reloading the exact same files (framework/renderer/react/index.tsx, ui/js/react/index.tsx) throughout, causing repeated page reloads; data-level correctness was confirmed via passing unit tests instead.
summary:
Wired the shared WorldProjectionSpec taxonomy into the Display "Fenster" (Windows) drag-and-drop palette:

- infinite/world/r3f/index.tsx: added encodeWorldProjectionTemplateId/decodeWorldProjectionTemplateId to serialize a spec into WindowTemplateDropPayload.templateId, plus round-trip tests.
- framework/renderer/react/index.tsx: buildDisplayWindowsTree now nests the full Parallel/Perspective tree (via createWorldProjectionTemplates) under any window kind whose surfaceKind is "world-3d", each leaf carrying an encoded templateId; non-world-3d kinds keep the original flat single entry. handleTemplateDrop decodes templateId and registers it in a new pendingWorldProjectionByWindowId side-channel, keyed by the newly created window instance id. Added WindowInstanceIdContext (wraps each window's InterpretedUiNode with its kind.id/instance.id) so World3dHost can identify which pane it is. World3dHost's viewportCamera now lazily seeds from the pending spec (via computeWorldProjectionPose) on first mount, then discards it — no Rust/WASM changes needed, since each dragged pane is an independent React component instance with its own local camera-override state.
- Tests: 3 new cases in framework/renderer/react/index.test.ts (nested taxonomy shape under a world-3d kind, flat fallback for non-world-3d kinds, drag-payload round-trip through decodeWorldProjectionTemplateId) plus 2 new infinite-world-r3f cases. Full suites: infinite-world-r3f 90/90 passed, framework-renderer-react 194/195 passed (the one failure is pre-existing unrelated WIP from a different concurrent session editing shell terminology locks in the same file).

Live E2E verification in the running Aggregator preview was inconclusive: the dev server's underlying files were being actively hot-reloaded by a different concurrent session throughout, causing repeated full-page reloads that made click-through testing (open Anzeige > Fenster > expand window-kind section > see nested Parallel/Perspective branches) impractical to complete reliably. Data-level correctness (tree shape, encode/decode, mount-time seeding logic) is confirmed by the passing unit tests instead; recommend a follow-up manual check once the shared dev server settles.
